notes.title: Escape/mystery adventure "Hornet the Vanguard2:The fox smirks" now on sale!
notes.notes:
An explosion occurs in the imperial capital as cherry blossoms fall.
A strange skeletal body is left behind at the scene...

Hachiya, a spy with a prosthetic arm, and his friends face a mysterious incident!

The sequel to the escape/detective adventure, "Hachi and the Avant-Garde 2: The Fox Laughs Under the Cherry Blossoms," was released today.
[previewyoutube=oZBhccYdlJw;full][/previewyoutube]

"I hate cherry blossoms. They bring back unpleasant memories" - one pursues the Fox Mask Gang for revenge,
"I love cherry blossoms. They remind me of an important promise" - another faces the incident for the sake of a childhood friend.

Grasp the truth from two different perspectives!

notes.title: Win a cast colored paper by lottery! Start of wishlist registration campaign
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177006/5159ce826c307c89d6e4c043a8d844c758923b55.jpg[/img]
Two people will be chosen by lottery from among those who have registered on the wishlist and applied to receive an autographed colored paper by Hochu Otsuka, who plays the role of Utagawa.
We are looking forward to receiving many applications!

<How to apply>
① “Hornet the Vanguard2:The fox smirks” Register to wishlist from the Steam store page.

②Save a screenshot or photo that shows you have registered.
(Please be careful not to show your personal information.)

③Post to X or Instagram using the following method.
・Add the hashtag “#蜂アヴァCP2”
・Attach the screenshot of ②
 

<Application period>
December 11, 2024 - January 31, 2025 (planned)

*Those who have already registered can also apply by posting on SNS.
*Please apply only once per person.
